verdict.rationale: The IRS runs machine channels (MeF XML transmission and IRIS A2A intake), so event notifications via webhooks are a fair question for this kind of service. However, nothing in the evidence documents any webhook or event-subscription mechanism. Probes found no OpenAPI spec or llms.txt, and the documented rails are submission-oriented: credentialed system-to-system transmission, portals behind ID.me sign-in, and paper or fax.
